summary: Frontend-only Playwright tests for Hyperbolic Triangle Explorer. All 10 critical scenarios from the review passed: initial equilateral/180° state, 2D vertex drag updates angles while sum stays 180 at K=0, curvature slider drives sum below 180 with concave sides, 2D↔3D toggle preserves shared math state (identical angle sum and per-vertex angles), right-drag orbits camera in 3D without altering math, right-click context menu suppressed, Reset restores 2D flat equilateral state. No console/page errors.
critical_code_review_comments: scene.js reset() correctly resets aRef, mode, morph, verts and camera, and onReset syncs React state (curvature + mode) — good.
contextmenu is preventDefault'd on the canvas element (verified defaultPrevented=true via dispatched event).
Right-drag only orbits in 3D (gated by `if (mode === '3d') orbiting = true`) and the triangle math is unaffected — correct per spec.
In 2D mode vertex-drag is constrained to the DOMAIN rectangle; at K=0 the sum stays exactly 180° regardless of vertex positions (observed: A=44.8°, B=89.7°, C=45.5° summing to 180.0°).

At K=-0.80, sum dropped to 81.0° (angles ~26-27° each). Values are much lower than typical textbook hyperbolic triangles at K=-0.8 for a triangle this size — this is a consequence of the saddle z=a(u²-v²) metric with large |a| and the geodesic solver; acceptable per the review note ('exact numbers may differ').

Minor: labels in 3D are projected overlays but their screen position relative to the 3D vertex sphere can be far from the sphere center (label offset ~0.52 in world-xy). Testing-wise, this doesn't affect data-testids, but automated vertex dragging via screen coords of vertex-label-* is unreliable in 3D — the sphere is not under the label. Not a user-facing bug since users can see and click the glowing sphere.
Minor: the reset button toast message is fine; curvature slider thumb loses focus after unrelated DOM updates — a UX nit for keyboard users but not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Default vertex screen positions at 1280x720 viewport (header 64px): A~(640,241), B~(510,465), C~(768,465). Use data-testid selectors (toggle-2d/3d, curvature-slider with [role=slider] thumb, curvature-value, angle-sum-value, telemetry-A/B/C, reset-btn). Right-click contextmenu is prevented via native event; confirmed by dispatching contextmenu MouseEvent and checking defaultPrevented. The slider is shadcn/radix; focusing the thumb and pressing ArrowRight (step=0.02) is the most reliable way to set curvature. In 3D mode, vertex spheres do NOT sit under the vertex-label-* overlays — the labels are offset outward by ~0.52 in world units; drag by raycasting the surface or by computing world-to-screen of the vertex position from scene state, not from the label.
